description: This file defines the ConstantValueMap class that manages mappings of tensor properties (like shape, value, rank, etc.) used in the ONNX shape inference and tensor analysis within the Torch JIT compiler pipeline.

classes.name: ConstantValueMap
classes.description: Singleton class managing tensor properties like shape, value, rank, and inference metadata during Torch JIT shape inference and optimization.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ConstantValueMap.

methods.name: SetRank
methods.description: Sets the rank of a tensor identified by its name.

methods.name: HasRank
methods.description: Checks if the rank for a tensor is set.

methods.name: GetRank
methods.description: Retrieves the rank of a tensor if available.

methods.name: SetAllGraphInputsStatic
methods.description: Sets whether all graph inputs are static.

methods.name: GetAllGraphInputsStatic
methods.description: Gets whether all graph inputs are static.

methods.name: SetAllGraphInputsReliableComputed
methods.description: Marks whether reliability of all graph inputs has been computed.

methods.name: GetAllGraphInputsReliableComputed
methods.description: Checks if reliability of all graph inputs has been computed.

methods.name: SetShape
methods.description: Associates a shape with a tensor identified by its name.

methods.name: HasShape
methods.description: Checks if shape information exists for a tensor.

methods.name: GetShape
methods.description: Retrieves the shape of a tensor.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Associates a tensor value with a tensor name.

methods.name: HasValue
methods.description: Checks if a tensor value exists for a given name.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the tensor value associated with a name.

methods.name: EraseValue
methods.description: Removes the stored tensor value for a given name.

methods.name: GetCompleteShapeInto1DInt64Vector
methods.description: Converts a symbolic shape into a 1D vector of int64.

methods.name: GetShapeInto1DInt64Vector
methods.description: Converts a shape associated with a tensor name into a 1D vector.

methods.name: GetShapeInto1DInt64VectorWithOneUnknown
methods.description: Converts a shape with potential unknowns into a 1D vector.

methods.name: GetValueInto1DInt64Vector
methods.description: Converts a tensor value into a 1D vector of int64.

methods.name: SetTypeReliable
methods.description: Sets whether tensor type information is reliable.

methods.name: HasTypeReliable
methods.description: Checks if type reliability is set for a tensor.

methods.name: GetTypeReliable
methods.description: Retrieves whether the tensor's type is reliable.

methods.name: SetUseInferredType
methods.description: Marks whether to use inferred type for a tensor.

methods.name: HasUseInferredType
methods.description: Checks if inferred type usage is set for a tensor.

methods.name: GetUseInferredType
methods.description: Retrieves whether inferred type is used for a tensor.

methods.name: SetShapeValue
methods.description: Sets a shape value for a tensor.

methods.name: HasShapeValue
methods.description: Checks if shape value exists for a tensor.

methods.name: GetShapeValue
methods.description: Retrieves the shape value for a tensor.

methods.name: GetInferredShapeData
methods.description: Returns shape inference data storage.

methods.name: GetSymbolDimMap
methods.description: Returns symbol dimension mapping.

methods.name: GetDimSymbolMap
methods.description: Returns dimension symbol mapping.

methods.name: UpdateValueName
methods.description: Updates the name of a tensor value.

methods.name: PrintMaps
methods.description: Prints internal maps for debugging.

methods.name: ClearMaps
methods.description: Clears all internal maps.
